mapper.sql: instance_id AS instanceId, definition_id AS definitionId, definition_version_id AS definitionVersionId, title, business_key AS businessKey, status, active_slot AS activeSlot, start_values_json AS startValuesJson, assignment_json AS assignmentJson, started_by AS startedBy, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, terminated_by AS terminatedBy, termination_reason AS terminationReason, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime

i.instance_id AS instanceId, i.definition_id AS definitionId, i.definition_version_id AS definitionVersionId, i.title, i.business_key AS businessKey, i.status, i.active_slot AS activeSlot, i.start_values_json AS startValuesJson, i.assignment_json AS assignmentJson, i.started_by AS startedBy, i.start_time AS startTime, i.end_time AS endTime, i.terminated_by AS terminatedBy, i.termination_reason AS terminationReason, i.version, i.create_time AS createTime, i.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_workflow_instance (instance_id, definition_id, definition_version_id, title, business_key, status, active_slot, start_values_json, assignment_json, started_by, start_time, end_time, terminated_by, termination_reason, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.instanceId}, #{row.definitionId}, #{row.definitionVersionId}, #{row.title}, #{row.businessKey}, #{row.status}, #{row.activeSlot}, #{row.startValuesJson}, #{row.assignmentJson}, #{row.startedBy}, #{row.startTime}, #{row.endTime}, #{row.terminatedBy}, #{row.terminationReason}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_workflow_instance SET status = #{row.status}, active_slot = IF(#{row.status} = 'RUNNING', active_slot, NULL), end_time = #{row.endTime}, terminated_by = #{row.terminatedBy}, termination_reason = #{row.terminationReason}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{row.updateTime} WHERE instance_id = #{row.instanceId} AND version = #{row.version} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_workflow_instance WHERE definition_id = #{definitionId} AND business_key = #{businessKey} AND active_slot = 1

where.if: AND (i.started_by = #{filter.participantId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_workflow_action_run a WHERE a.instance_id = i.instance_id AND (a.assignee_id = #{filter.participantId} OR a.submitted_by = #{filter.participantId})) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_workflow_approval p WHERE p.instance_id = i.instance_id AND p.approver_id = #{filter.participantId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_workflow_transfer r WHERE r.instance_id = i.instance_id AND (r.from_user_id = #{filter.participantId} OR r.to_user_id = #{filter.participantId})))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_workflow_instance i ORDER BY i.start_time DESC, i.instance_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT instance_id FROM t_workflow_instance WHERE JSON_SEARCH(start_values_json, 'one', #{fileAddress}, '!', '$.*[*]') IS NOT NULL AND instance_id <> #{excludeInstanceId} LIMIT 1
